turns.message: Follow the rails into the mine.
turns.reply:
You enter the Sorting Shed. A low cavern where miners once sorted ore. Plank tables stand among heaps of broken rock, and the rail track runs on, deeper into the hill. A kobold lookout yelps from a heap of rock and scrambles down, spike in hand. A kobold tunneller, an iron key bouncing on a cord at its neck, comes at you from behind a table.
Initiative: Kobold Lookout 8 + 2 = 10; Ada 4 + 2 = 6; Kobold Tunneller 1 + 2 = 3.
Kobold Lookout attacks Ada with Spike, at advantage (Pack Tactics): 15 and 20, keeping 20; 20 + 4 = 24 against AC 14. Critical hit! Damage 4 + 1 + 2 = 7 piercing; Ada has 21/28 HP.
It is your turn.
